newsitem.title: USA: APAC files for stock sale by shareholders.
newsitem.headline: APAC files for stock sale by shareholders.

text.p: APAC TeleServices Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for its shareholders, including the chairman, Theodore Schwartz, to sell up to 4.1 million common shares.

Of the total amount, 3.28 million common shares will be offered in the United States and Canada and 820,000 common shares will be sold in the international market, the filing said. The offering will bring the number of shares outstanding to 46,512,368.
Schwartz is also president, chief executive officer and director of the company.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 615,000 additional common shares. The offering will be underwriten by Merrill Lynch & Co, Lehman Brothers, Smith Barney Inc and William Blair & Co.
The telephone-based sales, marketing and customer management-services company is based in Deerfield, Illinois.
